notes: Merged old 18650 battery (k145) and 21700 battery (k146) into one kind with format types. Nine archetype cells from original makers (Panasonic, Samsung SDI, LG, Murata, Molicel), each sourced to a retrieved product/test page. Unarchetyped OEM models (EVE, BAK, DMEGC, Tenpower, Samsung 58E) kept in m. Left out: Samsung 30Q/40T/50S, Murata VTC5A, LG M50LT, Panasonic NCR18650GA and 14500/26650 named cells (no retrieved page or only search snippets); BAK/DMEGC/Tenpower brand entries (no page retrieved); rewrapped/relabelled cells (e.g. Epoch-wrapped Molicel) excluded as rewrap noise. nkon.nl blocked fetches (403).
